customManagers.description: ninja's release tags (vX.Y.Z). Renovate moves UPSTREAM_VERSION; the pins bot (.github/workflows/pins-bot.yml) writes the tag's commit and its tarball's SHA-256 into components/ninja/source on the branch.
clang22 N-1: release N of a family product is built by the previous clang22 release, so clang22 may itself depend on ninja without a cycle.
The family's GNU make, which runs the slice builds on both hosts.

packageRules.description: Renovate cannot compute a tarball SHA-256 or move a digest it does not read: the pins bot writes both into components/ninja/source on this branch.
prBodyNotes: components/ninja/source is written on this branch by .github/workflows/pins-bot.yml. If that bot failed, run `sh build/pin-source-tarball.sh` on this branch and commit components/ninja/source.
